about.title: About
about.intro: This studio turns Quran recitations into calm, shareable videos: the Arabic text and a translation of your choice appear over nature, space or mosque footage, ayah by ayah, in time with the recitation.
about.how1: Choose one or more passages, a reciter and a translation.
about.how2: Pick background themes, a format and a style, then create your videos.
about.how3: Download them, or share them straight to WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and more.
about.textBody: The Arabic text and the translations are shown exactly as published by QuranEnc.com — nothing is retyped or altered. A translation conveys the meanings; the Arabic text alone is the Quran.
about.sourceQuranEnc: Quran text and translations of the meanings
about.footageNote: Background clips are silent footage of nature, space, mosques and Islamic art. Every video credits its footage authors, and music is never added.
about.phoneText: Scan to open the studio on a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi network as this computer.
about.phonePublic: Scan to open the studio on your phone.
about.phoneNone: No network address was found. Connect this computer to Wi-Fi to open the studio from your phone.
